remediation_plan.triage_summary: Audit of Claim CLM-77192-C identifies root cause: CO-18 denial on CPT 99214.
remediation_plan.root_cause_analysis: Clinical EHR documentation establishes valid medical indications (L4), but claim intake crosswalk mistakenly listed non-qualifying code (M54.5), triggering adverse benefit determination CO-18.
required_evidence_criteria: Extract direct clinical quotations of physician Dr. Sarah Jenkins's objective findings.
Cite qualifying diagnostic code (L4) and applicable coverage policies.
Invoke federal ERISA 29 CFR § 2560.503-1 / ACA § 2719 statutory appeal review standards.
Demand immediate claim overturn and re-adjudication.

FORMAL STATUTORY APPEAL FOR CLAIM RE-ADJUDICATION
Date: 2026-02-05
To: Appeals & Grievance Department, Aetna Health
Re: Formal First-Level Statutory Appeal against Denial of Claim CLM-77192-C
Patient: Dominic Rossi | DOB: N/A
Member ID: AET-3391024 | Date of Service: 2026-02-05
Disputed Service: CPT 99214 | Disputed Denial Code: CO-18
Claim Amount: $215.0

1. STATEMENT OF DISPUTE
This letter constitutes a timely, formal appeal pursuant to 29 U.S.C. § 1133 and 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1 disputing the adverse benefit determination issued for CPT 99214. The denial under code CO-18 is erroneous and contrary to clinical record proof and established coverage guidelines.

2. CLINICAL FACTUAL SUBSTANTIATION & DIRECT EHR EVIDENCE
The medical record clearly establishes that the disputed service was medically necessary and fully indicated.
Treating Physician Documentation:
"CHIEF COMPLAINT: Follow-up evaluation for severe refractory lumbosacral radiculopathy and pre-procedure evaluation for scheduled trigger point injections.  EVALUATION & MANAGEMENT COMPONENT (Separate and Distinct - Modifier -25 justification): Patient evaluated in exam room 4 prior to any injection."
Verbatim Clinical Findings:
- Acute presentation documented by Dr. Sarah Jenkins.
- Primary diagnostic indication: L4.
- Secondary baseline complaint (M54.5) was erroneously billed as primary reason for service during registration intake.

3. STATUTORY & CODING CROSSWALK JUSTIFICATION
Under CMS Guidelines and ERISA regulations:
- Primary Qualifying Diagnosis: ICD-10 L4
- Procedure: CPT 99214
- Statutory Precedent: ERISA 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1(h)(2) requires a full and fair review taking into account all comments, documents, and records submitted.

4. DEMAND FOR REMEDY
We respectfully demand that Aetna Health overturn this adverse determination immediately and process CPT 99214 for full contractual payment within 30 statutory days.
